papers.summary_en_under200words: The work develops regression uncertainty measures from proper scoring rules and evaluates their use, including active learning. The inspected official implementation represents predictions by Gaussian ensemble means/variances, computes pointwise CRPS-derived Bayes/excess quantities, and samples queries from a softmax of those quantities. This is a direct precedent for proper-score acquisition, so that umbrella is not an original contribution here. The inspected path does not compute our proposed native-unit cross-target conditional lookahead or exact NIG only-Y update. That local code distinction is not an exhaustive novelty guarantee or evidence of better performance.
